entries.basis: Jay Shah explicitly tested the 2.0 turbo-petrol six-speed automatic, matching the rubric powertrain. Visible 8 Jan 2026 23:29 IST byline. Adds CarTrade as a second independent publisher beside two existing Autocar India tests. A third independent petrol-automatic publication is still needed; Moneycontrol, TopGear India and Team-BHP drove diesels and were not borrowed.

reviews.title: Mahindra XUV 7XO Petrol Automatic First Drive Review
reviews.quote: At low speeds, the steering feels light and makes the XUV 7XO easy to manoeuvre.

evidence.method: Opened original byline and exact tested powertrain in Engine and Powertrain section
